turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress to floor content]
    C --> D[Name evaporated content]
    D --> E[Find operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, direction, and flags]
    F --> G[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| H{Mode stated or inferable?}
    H -->|No| I[Ask for mode]
    I --> H
    H -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| J[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    J -->|Gaps| K[Ask one question or state assumptions]
    K --> J
    J -->|Pass| L[Compress the prompt]
    L --> M{Did the cut remove a requirement?}
    M -->|Yes| N[Name failure and restore last version]
    N --> L
    M -->|No| O{Two empty cuts?}
    O -->|No| P{Floor still passes?}
    P -->|No| Q[Return last passing version]
    P -->|Yes| L
    O -->|Yes| R[State that the contract is minimal]
    Q --> R
    R --> S[Output prompt, Cut, and notes]
    S --> T{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    T -->|Keep negotiating| L
    T -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| U{Execution tools available?}
    U -->|No| V[Gate stays closed]
    U -->|Yes| W[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    W --> X{Result}
    X -->|Success| Y[Done]
    X -->|Floor failure| Z[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    Z --> L
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: K -> J, P -> L
